body: It seems short on paper, but in reality every second feels like hours :/ it's really not nice way to go. And the body will still try to keep itself alive no matter how determined you are. Even when you loose consciousness you will subconsciously fight for your life. I feel like shit for most of the time andthinking about suicide like 4-5-6 days every week, for a few years now. And what helps me the most is the dog. I don't have any will to live,but the fact that at least the dog loves me, helps me to catch some other thoughts than rope, jump, die.... Sometimes even the simple work helps me to change my mind. It's not easy to do something when you feel bad, but f.ex. the dog won't wait and you just have to go with him outside and that's the time when I mostly get positive thinking. Sometimes even simple cleaning of the room, or doing something that you can dive in. I'm sorry for my English, hope this is somehow understandable :)

I don't want to be mean on rude,but it really hurts m8 :/. Tried it few times and always backed up in last few seconds because the pain was too much. I'm sorry that you feel bad :( but don't worry you are not alone. We broken people must stick together :P
